title: Phillips Curve Model for Colombia in Stata
goal: Estimate the relationship between inflation and unemployment in Colombia using a Phillips Curve model in Stata, guided step by step by Claude, and produce a full Stata .do file, an Excel results workbook, and a Word summary report as deliverables.
context: To analyze macroeconomic dynamics in Colombia, this project estimates the relationship between inflation and unemployment using a Phillips Curve model. The workflow transitions through six core stages: gathering official macroeconomic data, importing and organizing time series in Stata, running a baseline OLS regression, conducting diagnostic stress-tests for error violations, applying a Newey-West correction for robust standard errors, and synthesizing the final policy implications.

session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: It was enough time to produce the whole Phillips Curve analysis and three distinct deliverables: an Excel spreadsheet, a written Word report, and a complete Stata .do file containing detailed explanations of every econometric step performed

On my end, I ensured that the percentage formats matched across both series and that the Excel sheet was cleanly structured for Stata.
